values.label: plays here, on this page's track (new)

entries.look: Pick Laguna Seca, 2026 · Race 2, then press Replay this race beside the pickers: the race plays on this page's 3D track with his 9, the field, the race bar and his place. Exit replay returns to the heat map; changing the venue or race stops it. A race with no replay says so in one line.

entries.title: No black when you point at a section
entries.noswitch: the black was a fault you found; there is nothing to switch back to
entries.look: Point at any stretch of the track, above all where it climbs or drops (Barber's turns 1 to 4, Iowa's banking): it lights in its own colour with a thin dark edge, never black. Fixed at every venue.
